title: MIDI First Note
user: Piano teachers and hobbyists using browser exercises who need a five-minute, no-account way to verify that a MIDI keyboard, browser permissions, sound, and note mapping all work before a lesson.
smallest_useful_product: A static web app that detects MIDI ports, plays and labels received notes, measures round-trip tap timing, checks sustain and pitch-bend, and exports a redacted support card.
success_measure: 80% of first-time users obtain a green input-and-audio card in under three minutes; teachers report fewer than one setup interruption per five remote lessons.
constraints: Request only MIDI access needed for input; never retain device names or played notes unless the user downloads the card; disclose browser/platform limitations.
